description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer saved-cursor checkpoint: safe Rust owns DECSC/DECRC persistence of cursor position, delayed wrap, text attributes, DEC G0 charset and DECOM-relative restore/clamping semantics.

entries.notes: Safe Rust preserves position, delayed-wrap, TextAttribute and DEC special-graphics charset across repeated DECSC/DECRC; DECSTR resets the saved slot, and saved DECOM positions restore relative to the margins active at restore time with bottom/right clamping.
